subject.title: feat(workshop): allow restoring rejected proposals back to pending

question: Should rejected Skill Workshop proposals be restorable to pending, and must the rejection and restoration remain visible in an audit history?
rationale: This PR adds a new public lifecycle transition and clears the only rejection metadata, so code correctness alone cannot define the permanent product and history contract.

options.title: Restore with history
options.body: Accept restore, enforce identical configured limits across entry points, and retain explicit rejection and restoration events.

options.title: Restore current state only
options.body: Accept restore while documenting that rejection metadata is intentionally cleared and proposal records expose only current state.

options.title: Keep rejection terminal
options.body: Decline the new transition and retain proposal recreation as the supported recovery path.

recommendation.title: Restore with history
recommendation.body: Accept restore, enforce identical configured limits across entry points, and retain explicit rejection and restoration events.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Skill Workshop lifecycle, documentation, and Control UI surfaces trace to this person's feature history.
